t: The Americans suffered around 465 dead, wounded or captured, against 93 for Johnson's force; about half of Herkimer's men were killed or wounded.
The ambush was sprung too early, and a sortie from Fort Stanwix looted the Indigenous camps, which led the warriors to break off the fight to protect their women and possessions.
The battle began a civil war among the Haudenosaunee, as Oneida and Tuscarora warriors sided with the Patriots and the Mohawk, Seneca, Cayuga and Onondaga with the Loyalist cause.
dyk: Many of the men who fought each other at Oriskany had been neighbours, and the Royal Yorkers' ruse of turning their coats inside out to pass as a relief party from the fort failed when a Patriot captain recognised a Loyalist neighbour.
ev: Britain launches a two-pronged attack from Quebec, with Burgoyne coming down Lake Champlain and St. Leger down the Mohawk Valley
Herkimer issues a proclamation warning of British activity and calls out the Tryon County militia after Oneida allies report the British close to Fort Stanwix
St. Leger besieges Fort Stanwix and Herkimer's column sets out from Fort Dayton and camps near Oriska
Johnson's force ambushes Herkimer's column in a ravine near Oriska
A sortie from Fort Stanwix under Marinus Willett raids the Indigenous and Loyalist camps, and the warriors break off the fighting
Herkimer dies on 16 August of his wounds
Benedict Arnold's relief column reaches Fort Stanwix and the besiegers withdraw
John Butler is authorised to raise Butler's Rangers, with Indian Department rangers from Oriskany as its core

f.place: A marshy ravine about 6 miles (10 km) east of Fort Stanwix, near the Oneida village of Oriska, in the Mohawk Valley of New York
f.sides: Tryon County militia, about 800 men, and between 60 and 100 Oneida warriors under Brigadier General Nicholas Herkimer; against a force of roughly 500 under Lieutenant Colonel Sir John Johnson, mostly Mohawk, Seneca, Cayuga, Onondaga and Mississauga warriors led by Sayenqueraghta, Cornplanter and Joseph Brant, with Royal Yorkers and Indian Department rangers
f.outcome: The Americans lost around 465 dead, wounded or captured and Johnson's force 93; the relief column was stopped and Herkimer was mortally wounded, but a sortie from Fort Stanwix looted the warriors' camps and the fighting broke off.
